baselineCoverage.definition: At least one sourced English meaning or reviewed grammatical reading; not every meaning, usage or possible grammatical interpretation. No morphology-only fallback, untranslated lemma or placeholder counts.

guards: Preserve existing lower-case/common-noun meanings, especially ESCOCIA scotia. Adding a name sense must append rather than replace them.
Names are source-specific lexical readings of accepted guesses, not automatic answer eligibility or general unchanged-name fallback.
Retain source capitalization in citation URLs and original raw grammar in audit; do not assert unreviewed grammatical gender in English panels.
LATVIA and QUINTÍN remain held; no GPL FreeDict data or inferred identity mapping is admitted.
